scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: A version timeline
scenes.caption: In the Decision Lab, Vihaan records a fictional bulletin timeline. An independent snapshot contains twelve approved entries. The working file later gains three entries, then two. Aditi separates these additions to measure the recovery cost.
scenes.speech: In the Decision Lab, Vihaan records a fictional bulletin timeline. An independent snapshot contains twelve approved entries. The working file later gains three entries, then two. Aditi separates these additions to measure the recovery cost.
scenes.dialogue: Record what each recovery point actually contains.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: The unwanted edit spreads
scenes.caption: An unwanted edit replaces the bulletin text and synchronizes to its linked copy. Both views show the unwanted result. Vihaan notices that matching copies provide no earlier clean state when synchronization carries the same change across.
scenes.speech: An unwanted edit replaces the bulletin text and synchronizes to its linked copy. Both views show the unwanted result. Vihaan notices that matching copies provide no earlier clean state when synchronization carries the same change across.
scenes.dialogue: Matching copies can share the same problem.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: An independent point remains
scenes.caption: The independent snapshot was not part of that synchronization. It retains the approved entries according to its manifest. The teacher warns that it is only a recovery candidate; opening and comparing the restored result remain necessary.
scenes.speech: The independent snapshot was not part of that synchronization. It retains the approved entries according to its manifest. The teacher warns that it is only a recovery candidate; opening and comparing the restored result remain necessary.
scenes.dialogue: A candidate copy is not a completed recovery.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose with the cost visible
scenes.caption: Aditi compares the available points. The synchronized copy includes the unwanted edit; the independent snapshot predates the additions. Choosing the clean point means recovering an older state and accounting for missing work, without promising a lossless return.
scenes.speech: Aditi compares the available points. The synchronized copy includes the unwanted edit; the independent snapshot predates the additions. Choosing the clean point means recovering an older state and accounting for missing work, without promising a lossless return.
scenes.dialogue: Clean and latest are different properties.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Restore into a test area
scenes.caption: With the teacher, they restore the independent snapshot into a separate test area. They preserve the damaged file for review. They compare the restored title, entry identifiers and expected count with the manifest before declaring the rehearsal successful.
scenes.speech: With the teacher, they restore the independent snapshot into a separate test area. They preserve the damaged file for review. They compare the restored title, entry identifiers and expected count with the manifest before declaring the rehearsal successful.
scenes.dialogue: Test the restored contents, not just the open button.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Resume with a record
scenes.caption: The older-state comparison passes. Their restore record lists the later additions that need verified re-entry and the teacher responsible for resuming work. Your evidence must describe recovered content and work still missing from that point.
scenes.speech: The older-state comparison passes. Their restore record lists the later additions that need verified re-entry and the teacher responsible for resuming work. Your evidence must describe recovered content and work still missing from that point.
scenes.dialogue: A verified older state can still need rebuilding.
